name: agora_exterior
description: The sunlit exterior of the stoa shows classic Doric columns encircling the building, with soft grass edging the walkway and a friendly, welcoming square.

color_palette: Chalk White (#F5F2E8) for limewashed columns and entablature to keep the façade bright and clean.
Limestone Beige (#D8C7A2) for wall surfaces and steps to match the interior tones.
Terracotta (#C65D3A) for roof tiles and amphora accents along the portico.
Cedar Brown (#6E4B3A) for wooden doors and beam ends under the eaves.
Aegean Blue (#2E86AB) for pottery, simple symbol signage, and fabric ties.
Olive Green (#6B8E23) for olive leaves and laurel shrubs around the steps.
Meadow Green (#6FAE3E) for the grassy verge that frames the walkway.
visual_style.architectural_style: Classical Greek stoa exterior with a Doric peristyle wrapping the building, whitewashed limestone walls, and a low stepped stylobate leading to the colonnade. A shallow terracotta-tiled roof with simple rafter ends echoes the calm interior style.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Short meadow grass borders the stone path, with potted olive and small laurel shrubs near the steps. Sparrows hop along the stylobate and a friendly cat naps in the shade.
materials: Whitewashed limestone blocks for walls, steps, and Doric columns.
Terracotta roof tiles and amphorae for warm, historic accents.
Cedar wood for doors, rafters, and discreet trim; bronze for hinges and lamp fittings.
